evidence_items.explanation: The January assessment supports serious concern about unsupervised legal use. Its publication date dates that assessment, not the underlying experiments; it does not establish the impossibility of every mission-critical workflow.

This earlier study reports mitigation with residual hallucinations. It is background evidence against equating an unsolved problem with an unmitigable one, but supplies neither a target-period deployment result nor proof of mission-critical reliability.
